title: The Seinfeld Chronicles
excerpt: The Seinfeld Chronicles digital edition visually and sonically presents an entirely unnecessary data-driven exploration of every episode of Seinfeld.
content_html:
I was a late arrival to Seinfeld fandom.

Scroll down

or

Use keyboard arrows

Though the first episode was aired in the US in 1989, there would be a four-year delay until it was broadcast in the UK. As a teenager, and with the show lurking in the shadows of BBC's late-night schedules, it passed me by.

It wasn't until the 2010s when Seinfeld reappeared on UK TV in a prime-time slot. Fully aware of the show's standing in the canon of popular culture, this was my opportunity to tune in.

During the 2010s Seinfeld was also shown on cable networks, like Comedy Central, and then from 2015 became available on-demand in the USA on Hulu.

In 2019, Netflix spent over $500 million for the global streaming rights to broadcast Seinfeld from 2021 through to 2026. This propelled the show to a whole new generation of audiences.

Seinfeld returns to UK prime-time on Sky TV

Seinfeld available on-demand on Hulu in the USA

2021

Seinfeld launches on Netflix with worldwide streaming

If you’ve still never seen the show, let me bring you up to speed with a quick intro and explain why I became hooked after only a handful of episodes.

We'll learn a lot more about all the characters and locations later.

I was intrigued by the possibilities of mixing work with pleasure: visually exploring a sitcom through its data.

Intrigued became compelled. I wanted to explore how Seinfeld and David, with the support of their evolving pool of talented writers, managed to achieve such sustained sitcom brilliance. Much like a sports coach seeks to assemble the right players in the right combinations, to win a game, how did the Seinfeld ‘coaching team’ use their resources to assemble the right characters in the right scenes, in order to score the laughs and create TV gold?

A few years later, I decided it was time to revisit this work and develop a new format that could reach a wider audience.

Presenting, The Seinfeld Chronicles: Digital Edition.

Let’s go back to the start. Seinfeld aired on US TV for the first time on Wednesday 5th July 1989, with a pilot episode titled 'Good News, Bad News'.

Though it was watched by 15.4M viewers, the early reviews were mixed - test audiences hated it, TV critics liked it - so its future was initially uncertain. However, thanks to the perseverance and persuasion of NBC executive Rick Ludwin, four more episodes were belatedly ordered to complete the unusually short first season.

This opening season belatedly wrapped a year later, in the summer of 1990, and was now receiving warmer ratings from critics and audiences alike. This response was positive enough to convince NBC to commission a second season, this time comprising 12 episodes.

Despite a slightly rocky start with Season Two, critical reviews and audience ratings continued to improve giving NBC reason to not only green-light a third season but to move the show into the sought-after Fall schedule, where buzz, anticipation, and advertising revenues peak.

Towards the middle of Season Four the show was moved to Thursdays, straight after Cheers, in the most popular prime-time slot.

When the final episode was broadcast, on 14th May 1998, it brought to an end nine seasons and a total of 180 episodes.

The data for this project was manually recorded through watching the DVD boxset of every one of the 176 written episodes (ignoring 4 specials/highlight shows).

虽然第一集于 1989 年在美国播出，但推迟了四年才在英国播出。 当我十几岁的时候，这部剧潜伏在 BBC 深夜节目的阴影中，它与我擦肩而过。

直到 2010 年代，《宋飞正传》才重新出现在英国电视黄金时段。 充分意识到该节目在流行文化经典中的地位，这是我收听的机会。

2010 年代，《宋飞正传》还在 Comedy Central 等有线电视网络上播出，然后从 2015 年开始在美国的 Hulu 上点播。

2019 年，Netflix 斥资超过 5 亿美元购买了 2021 年至 2026 年《宋飞正传》的全球流媒体播放权。 这将这部剧推向了全新一代的观众。

我对将工作与娱乐相结合的可能性很感兴趣：通过数据直观地探索情景喜剧。

好奇变成了被迫。 我想探索《宋飞正传》和大卫如何在他们不断发展的才华横溢的作家队伍的支持下，成功地取得了如此持续的情景喜剧辉煌。 就像体育教练寻求以正确的组合组合正确的球员来赢得比赛一样，《宋飞正传》的“教练团队”如何利用他们的资源在正确的场景中组合正确的角色，以博取笑声并创造电视黄金？

几年后，我决定是时候重新审视这部作品并开发一种可以吸引更广泛受众的新格式了。

宋飞传编年史

“宋飞传编年史”也被称为“好消息，坏消息”，或者简称为“试播集”，是美国流行情景喜剧《宋飞正传》试播集的标题。

让我们回到开头。 《宋飞正传》于 1989 年 7 月 5 日星期三在美国电视台首次播出，试播集标题为“好消息，坏消息”。

尽管有 1540 万观众观看，但早期的评论褒贬不一——测试观众讨厌它，电视评论家喜欢它——所以它的未来最初是不确定的。 然而，多亏了 NBC 执行官瑞克·路德温 (Rick Ludwin) 的坚持和说服，才终于又订了四集来完成异常短暂的第一季。

一年后，即 1990 年夏天，第一季终于结束，现在收到了评论家和观众的热烈好评。 这一反响非常积极，足以说服 NBC 委托制作第二季，这次包含 12 集。

尽管第二季的开局稍显坎坷，但评论界和收视率持续提高，这让 NBC 不仅有理由批准第三季，而且将该剧移至广受欢迎的秋季档，届时热度、预期和广告收入将达到顶峰。

在第四季中期，该节目被移至周四，紧接在最受欢迎的黄金时段《干杯》之后。

当最后一集于1998年5月14日播出时，九季共180集就结束了。

该项目的数据是通过观看 176 集书面剧集中每一集的 DVD 盒装手动记录的（忽略 4 个特别节目/精彩节目）。
